category: usenet provider (Dutch, one unlimited plan with one-off payments)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial on the order page read; the order summary shows TurboTurbo for 365 days at EUR 54.95.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; retrieval is by Usenet article over NNTP
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: unverified: the order page read does not state retention; a third-party index says over 3,900 days

egress.terms: Unlimited speed and unlimited data on the single plan (third-party index)

tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: One plan priced per day; the order page shows the 365-day price, and the vendor says payments are one-off, so there is no renewal to cancel.
limits_note: TurboTurbo for 365 days is EUR 54.95; the shorter periods were not read.
binding_note: Speed and volume are unlimited per the third-party index, so the connection count is the stated bound.

identity_cost.detail: The order page says payments are one-off and 'We do not store info'. The form asks for name, email address, password and country, then a payment method; several card and card-free methods are listed, including cryptocurrencies. No card is required by the form itself.

reliability_note: The order page names NectoFarm B.V. as the statement name; the backbone is not stated by the vendor.
confidence_note: The 365-day price is on the vendor order page; plan limits are from a third-party index.

evidence.proved: the order summary prices the plan at EUR 54.95

evidence.quote: TurboUsenet is a Dutch provider based in Arnhem, offering a single no-nonsense plan called TurboTurbo – unlimited speed, 50 connections, over 3,900 days retention, and transparent per-day pricing. Perfect for users who want Usenet without the frills.
